description:
A top American university helped develop cutting-edge biotech alongside Chinese institutions with deep ties to the CCP and the Chinese military. In this episode of China Uncensored, we look at University of Washington professor Gao Dayong, his connections to Chinese military-linked organizations, and why UW appears to have scrubbed some of those ties from its public pages.
